requirements: docs/61 Thresholds, priors and independent gate calibration
scenarios: the real verification engine runs cargo test on the rust-cli fixture for 8 held-out acceptance candidates in two new defect lineages; the real invariants, rules and Acceptance Gate decide; two hidden oracles label each candidate

the two candidates the visible tests cannot tell from correct (an overfitted zero check, an off-by-one maximum) are the gate's false accepts; the two that break formatting are rejected; the four correct ones accepted

18 risk cases through modbit_policy::derive_realized_risk against oracle labels: a dependency bump and a payments change not sent to review are false negatives; a .env.production change not treated as a secret is a critical-surface miss

rates on separate denominators with Wilson 95% intervals: acceptance false accept 2/4, false reject 0/4, realized-risk false negative 3/13, false positive 0/5, critical-surface miss 1/6; per leg the initial leg's false accepts are 2/3 and the escalation's 0/1

without an approved threshold profile the release check fails MISSING_THRESHOLD_PROFILE; a strict (test-only) profile with a router saving 5000 minor units still fails UNSAFE_GATE and INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLES; a profile missing a rate is MISSING_THRESHOLD; a permissive (test-only) profile passes

a holdout lineage shared with the competence suite is refused Contaminated; one shared between the two holdouts SharedLineage; a candidate declared correct that its oracle rejects is refused Mislabeled
audit: NOT-FOUND before: the EPR-008 corpus pinned the risk rules' outputs as a tuning/regression set; nothing measured the gate or the rules against oracle labels on held-out data, and nothing could fail a release on an unsafe gate.
proof: The Acceptance Gate and RealizedRisk, unchanged, measured independently on committed held-out corpora with hidden oracles; every case and rate pinned; the release check fails without an approved profile and on an unsafe gate whatever the router saves.
negative_proof: EPR-FI-019 mutation: suppressing critical misses in the risk comparison fails the pinned test; contaminated, shared-lineage and mislabeled holdouts are refused before measurement.
limitations: No approved threshold profile exists: the release check fails until the owner approves one (docs/61 invents no numbers), so EPR-GATE-D, E and G stay OPEN on that decision. The corpora are small (8 + 18) and the intervals wide. The acceptance corpus uses one fixture language (Rust); the risk corpus is facts, not repositories. The found .env.* rule defect is its own task.

ci.note: every job green on macOS, Linux and Windows on the first attempt, including the cloud job on SeaweedFS after the MinIO images were withdrawn

remeasurements.why: the .env.* secret-surface defect this suite found was fixed as an EPR-008 regression
remeasurements.result: env-production CRITICAL with review and a human, no longer a false negative or a critical miss; risk false negatives 2/13 (dependency-bump, payments-charge), false positives 0/5, critical-surface misses 0/6 (Wilson upper 0.39, so the strict test profile still fails UNSAFE_GATE); acceptance rates unchanged
remeasurements.independence: env-production informed the fix and no longer counts as independent evidence for the secret surface; an approved profile relying on critical_surface_miss_rate needs fresh critical-surface cases in new lineages
remeasurements.fault_injection: the test also judges env-production under the pre-fix rules (secret surface without .env.*) and requires a counted critical miss; disabling critical_miss in run_risk_case fails it
remeasurements.wilson: bounds clamp to their side of the estimate; 0/6 had computed a lower bound of 2.8e-17 above a rate of 0
